limits: Source and browser checks at R level on one WSL2 machine against a local vite preview; not a pilot measurement and not a field measurement.
The 4G profile is Chrome DevTools network emulation (150 ms RTT, 1.6 Mbps), not a measured mobile network; the 2.70 s LCP at 1440 is that emulation's number.
The 30k scale envelope is designed for, not measured; no latency figure is published on the page.
Contrast is measured on the composited page at each section's own scroll position and at the hero anchor, not on every frame of the film.

Frame budget is measured with Chrome's 4x CPU throttle on a quiet machine; frame interval is rAF cadence, which is floored at the 16.7 ms vsync and therefore bounds, rather than reports, main-thread work per frame.
The anti-slop screenshot test was read by the gate agent, not by an engineer outside the project; a human reading counts for more.
pnpm test:e2e was run against the default config on port 4331; the landing suite was run through a temporary config on port 4381 because port 4332 is held by a process outside this sandbox.
